#+title: P1 — preregistered readiness and horizon trials
#+PROBE-STATUS: active

* Question and predictions
:PROPERTIES:
:ID: live-rendering-p1-plan
:LENS: empiricist adversarial
:END:

Can existing frame facts distinguish unfinished eligible work from future authored
sleep? Can a probe-local horizon accumulator preserve the same fixed question while
excluding paused wall time? No runtime edits, new graph, packages or browser.

Before running [[file:p1.mjs][p1.mjs]], predictions are:
- A registry reference traversal will find the P0 descendant that atCut skips.
- Traversal repair alone will not be a reason-complete gate: a closed frame can
  still have a due next transition; a pending derived move can coexist with cuts.
- A due-frame gate will permit future sleep, hold finite breathed work and
  async/credit pressure, and resume without adding the held intervals.
- A dataflow suspension alone will not certify whether retry can progress.
  Repeated unchanged ticks are evidence against a blind retry policy.
- Zero-time recurrence returns at spent slices but can retain H indefinitely.
  Censor its observation, do not invent a truth bound or call it healthy sleeping.

* Isolated comparisons
:PROPERTIES:
:ID: live-rendering-p1-trials
:END:

1. Reason panel: frozen work clock, channel 512, one tick per measurement,
   deadline -1 only for CPU-breath fixtures. Compare getters with registry facts.
   Release credit or deliver one admission reply, changing nothing else.
   Include future sleep, done, failure, descendant-after-wait, missing/forward
   references, mutual cycle, recursive steps with/without waits, permanent block,
   and a real derived move after cached completion.
2. Horizon pairs: same source, capacity, breath cadence, identity admission,
   one spent-slice tick per opportunity and full post-tick drain. Control H is
   opportunity wall time; treatment H is a driver-only accumulator. Fixed
   opportunities 10 units apart; work clock counts admitted motions. No cut
   extension, preferred macros or controller. This deliberately tests a smaller
   driver model than the real compositor; P0 is its current-driver control.
3. Compare canonical per-address path segments (not ring batching), admission
   requests with logical time, errors and final committed poses. For waited
   recurrence compare a declared logical-prefix stop, not equal wall time.
4. Hold an unanswered admission at H=0 for eight additional ticks with no reply.
   If the due-frame policy calls for unchanged retries, reject its liveness claim.
   Preserve the absent-name falsifier separately; it is not a permanent block.
   Do not silently add a wake graph to rescue the candidate.

* Replication, falsifiers and stopping
:PROPERTIES:
:ID: live-rendering-p1-stopping
:END:

Pilot correction (before final trials): the runtime checks =clock() > deadline=,
not >=. Frozen clock 0 with allowance 0 was not spent and failed to exercise
breath. Use allowance -1 to force an already-spent slice. Retain pilot raw output,
error and instrument snapshot; this is an instrument repair, not runtime evidence.
Pilot 2 correction: closed figure bodies override requested breathEvery with 256;
64 motions never reached that checkpoint. Increase only that workload to 600.
Pilot 3 falsifies the missing-name-as-permanent-block expectation: it wounds when
the parent closes. Retain that fixture and use an explicitly withheld admission
reply for the permanent external-block experiment. Do not call this a dataflow result.
Pilot 4 falsifies the endless-recursion expectation on this host: recursive
delegation reaches a stack fault after some returned slices. Record that terminal
fault instead of insisting it must remain censored. No language bound is changed.

Run two independent processes and compare complete deterministic JSONL. Assertions
fail on divergent meaning, advanced sleeping before its due time, catch-up debt,
missing expected witnesses or exceeded finite-fixture observation ceilings. Emit
states before asserting, so inconvenient observations survive. Infinite cases are
explicitly censored. All ceilings belong to the instrument, not PaperLang.

Reject promotion if any gate reason is ambiguous, permanent-block retry spins,
frame scanning is required without a cost result, or meaning diverges. A scan is
an O(frames) reference instrument, NOT the small runtime summary being sought.
Count its visited frames exactly; do not pass synthetic work units off as latency.

P1 success on finite fixtures does not approve the live policy. P2/P3/P4 treatment
integration, P7 candidate validation and P5/P6 browser trials remain gated on an
authoritative stop/wake summary. Independent existing regressions may still run.

* Evidence seat and exit
:PROPERTIES:
:ID: live-rendering-p1-plan-exit
:END:

Raw runs live under [[file:records/][records/]]; findings belong to
[[file:RESULTS.org][RESULTS.org]]. Conclude this plan after both runs, retaining
rejected candidates and the next smallest question. Replay remains deferred.
